title: The cut-off radial operator Φ(ω) = ζ·Hω on test forms
statement:
Let P, m ∈ ℕ and r ∈ ℝ. Assume (H): for every C^∞ (m+1)-form ω : ℝ^P → Λ_{m+1} there is a C^∞ m-form ψ : ℝ^P → Λ_m such that
(i) ψ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^m ω(tx)(x, v) dt for all x ∈ ℝ^P and v ∈ (ℝ^P)^m;
(iii) for all j ∈ ℕ and R, D ∈ ℝ with D ≥ 0: if ‖D^iω(y)‖ ≤ D for every i ≤ j and every y with ‖y‖ ≤ R, then ‖D^jψ(x)‖ ≤ (R + j)·D for every x with ‖x‖ ≤ R.
Then there is an ℝ-linear map Φ : D^{m+1}(ℝ^P) → D^m(ℝ^P) (test forms on univ) such that:
(a) for every sequence (ω_l) of (m+1)-test forms, TestFormOnConverges ω 0 implies TestFormOnConverges (l ↦ Φ(ω_l)) 0;
(b) Φ(ω)(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^m ω(tx)(x, v) dt for every ω ∈ D^{m+1}(ℝ^P), every x in the open ball B_r(0) and every v ∈ (ℝ^P)^m.
Here (x, v) := Fin.cons x v. Hypothesis (H) is exactly the statement of iwl_cr_radial_operator instantiated at k := m, a := m, with its fderiv item (ii) removed. iwl_cr_radial_operator is the parent's own frozen dependency, not a child of this decomposition, and the parent discharges (H) with it.
